LESSON: ENVIRONMENTAL

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.4: Environmental

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Environmental. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Environmental
2. Practise Environmental at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Environmental

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Environmental
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Environmental. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Environmental at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Environmental at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Environmental
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Environmental. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Environmental using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Environmental in the examples.
2. Explain Environmental to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Environmental.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Environmental using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Environmental important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Environmental
2. Practise Environmental at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Environmental

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
